verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data, plus a Boleto lifecycle API, webhooks, and TypeScript/Python SDKs. Its official MCP server also exposes many UI actions without opening the app: issuing virtual cards, setting limits, paying vendors, submitting reimbursements, and querying or exporting transactions. However, no documentation claims full API/UI parity, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement; API coverage of team and role/permission management, approval flows, FX conversion between Jeeves Cash accounts, and receipt/invoice scanning; a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent corroboration.
